name: esp32s3-devkit
description: Generic ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 dev kit (board marked esp32-s3-dev-kit-nxrx; NxxRxX module variant - bump flash_size below if it is a 16MB N16 part, layout works from 4MB up anyway). Dual-core Xtensa LX7 240MHz, USB-OTG. Addressable RGB LED on GPIO48 on classic DevKitC-1 wiring (newer revisions use GPIO38); BOOT button on GPIO0.
